ui.about.title: Game da Watchcoin (WTC)
ui.about.p1: Watchcoin manhaja ce ta yin ayyuka da samun lada. Kana yin gajerun ayyuka masu sauƙi, kamar kallon bidiyo, so, subscribe ko amsa ƙuri'a, kuma kana samun tokens na WTC kan kowanne.
ui.about.h1: Aƙalla sababbin ayyuka 5 kowace rana, kowanne da ladansa
ui.about.h2: Kyautar jerin kwanaki ta kowace rana, da juya ƙafar kyauta idan ka gama duk ayyukan ranar
ui.about.h4: WTC 50 kan kowane aboki da ka gayyata da ya gama aiki
ui.about.h5: Tsarin Premium yana ba ka ƙarin ayyuka kowace rana
ui.about.launchIn: Za a ƙaddamar da WTC nan da {t}
ui.about.launchSoon: Ranar ƙaddamar da WTC tana zuwa
ui.about.launchP: {launch}. Har zuwa lokacin, ma'aunin WTC ɗinka yana cikin aminci a manhajar. Za a buɗe turawa da canza WTC bayan ƙaddamarwa, kuma za a bayyana cikakken bayani a manhajar kafin lokacin.
ui.about.usdtP: Adadin USDT da kake gani kimantawa ne. Yana amfani da farashin manhajar kanta (1 WTC = {p} USDT) kuma ba farashin wata kasuwa ba ne. Bayan ƙaddamarwa, ainihin ƙimar WTC a kasuwa na iya hawa, sauka, ko ba ta da ƙima ko kaɗan.
ui.about.readP: Babu wanda zai iya yin alkawarin cewa WTC zai sami ƙimar kuɗi, ko cewa wani zai ci riba ta riƙe shi. Sami WTC don nishaɗi ko a matsayin ƙari. Ka biya tsarin Premium ne kawai idan ba damuwa ka rasa kuɗin, kuma kada ka taɓa cin bashi don shiga.
ui.about.fairP: Asusu ɗaya ga kowane mutum. Bot, asusun ƙarya da yaudara suna kai wa ga hana shiga da rasa tokens. Kana da tambaya ko matsala? Aika ta daga shafin Ni.
ui.install.title: Shigar da Watchcoin
ui.install.sub: Ƙara manhajar a allon gidanka. Tana buɗewa da sauri, kamar kowace manhaja.
ui.install.iosTitle: Shigar da Watchcoin a iPhone ɗinka
ui.install.ios: Danna maɓallin Raba, sannan “Ƙara zuwa Allon Gida”.
ui.install.openBrowser: Buɗe wannan shafin a burauzarka (Chrome ko Safari) don shigar da manhajar.
